In this video, we dive deep into Dogecoin (DOGE) — the original meme coin that continues to capture market attention. After a period of sideways movement, DOGE is now approaching a critical price zone that could determine its next major direction. Traders are watching closely as momentum begins to shift. 👀

We’ll break down:

👉 What to watch if DOGE fails to hold its key support zone

Whether Dogecoin breaks out for another rally or faces another pullback, this analysis gives you a clear technical roadmap to understand what’s next for this iconic crypto. Stay tuned till the end for full insights and realistic price projections. 🚀

asr.full_text: This is Shah and Dowge is currently showing something very important that most traders miss and that is relative strength compared to the rest of the market this is exactly the kind of behavior you want to identify early because it often leads to stronger moves later right now DOGE is trading around 0.092 in the last update we clearly mark the support at 0.090 and that level has now been tested multiple times. Each time price comes into that zone it is getting a reaction which tells us that buyers are actively defending it. The first time price dropped into 0.090 it gave a strong bounce that was already a good sign because strong reactions from support show demand in the market. But what happened after that is even more important. When Bitcoin dropped sharply toward the 65,000s on almost the entire altcoin market followed that move. Most coins broke down, lost their supports and made new lows that is typical behavior, because altcoins usually move in sync with Bitcoin, but DOGE behaved differently. Instead of breaking down and continuing lower, DOGE came back to the same 0.090 level again. This time, it even moved slightly below it, forming a long wick. But instead of continuing downward, price immediately reversed and bounced back up. This is what we call a liquidity sweep. That move below support is designed to trigger stop losses of traders who place their risk just under the level. It also attracts sellers expecting a breakdown but once that liquidity is taken, the market reverses sharply, trapping those positions. This kind of price action is not weakness. It is actually a sign of strength. It shows that buyers are stepping in aggressively and absorbing selling pressure – even when the broader market is weak. Now, this repeated defense of 0.090 makes it a very strong support level. As long as price continues to hold above it, the short-term structure remains bullish. From here, the next level to watch is 0.095. This is the immediate resistance, and it becomes the next target as long as support holds. If Doge manages push upward and break above $0.095 this relative strength becomes even more significant. That would signal that buyers are in full control and that the market can continue higher. However, you still need to respect the downside risk. If price loses $0.090 with a clean breakdown and fails to reclaim it, then the structure weakens and the bullish scenario becomes invalid. So the plan is very simple and based on clear levels. As long as 0.090 holds, direction remains toward 0.095. A confirmed breakout strengthens the bullish case even further.
